basic_info.description: Welcome to 650 Steiner Street! Unit 6 is a stunning top floor condo up the street from the iconic "Painted Ladies" on historic Alamo Square Park.  This two bedroom urban retreat has the perfect open floorplan. The spacious dining/ living area looks out over the verdant park and east to peek-a-boo views of the city. The bedrooms are well sized with generous closets. This condo is equipped with state-of-the-art smart home features including Brilliant control panels, Mysa smart thermostats and a Tesla Universal EV Charger conveniently located in the garage. The kitchen is well appointed with a Caf Smart Oven that integrates with home systems like Google Home and Alexa. The bathroom is like a relaxing spa with heated floors, a full body shower system, and a LED lighted vanity mirror. A skylight in the hallway fills the unit with natural light. There is a shared spacious back deck for grilling, extra storage and one car side-by-side parking. Enjoy the vibrant cafes and shops of the adjacent neighborhoods of NOPA and Hayes Valley!
